name: zcode-plugin-honcho
description: Fail-open Honcho memory for ZCode sessions.

description_i18n.en: Fail-open Honcho memory for ZCode sessions.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为 ZCode 会话提供 fail-open 的 Honcho 长期记忆。

honcho_api_key.title: Honcho API key
honcho_api_key.description: Honcho API key. Stored locally and used only by the hook process.

honcho_base_url.title: Honcho base URL
honcho_base_url.description: Honcho API host, for example https://api.honcho.dev.

honcho_workspace_id.title: Honcho workspace ID
honcho_workspace_id.description: Workspace shared by the agent integrations that should share memory.

honcho_peer_id.title: Honcho user peer ID
honcho_peer_id.description: Stable peer ID for the person whose memory is being built.

honcho_assistant_peer_id.title: Honcho assistant peer ID
honcho_assistant_peer_id.description: Peer ID used for ZCode assistant messages.

inject_context.title: Inject recalled context
inject_context.description: Add bounded Honcho context at session start.

capture_prompts.title: Capture user prompts
capture_prompts.description: Include user prompts in Honcho messages.

capture_responses.title: Capture assistant responses
capture_responses.description: Include final assistant responses in Honcho messages.

max_context_chars.title: Maximum context characters
max_context_chars.description: Maximum characters injected into ZCode at session start.

max_capture_chars.title: Maximum capture characters
max_capture_chars.description: Maximum characters stored per user or assistant message.

debug.title: Debug diagnostics
debug.description: Write non-sensitive lifecycle diagnostics to stderr.
